> [!CAUTION]
> # 🚨 警惕远程控制诈骗！
> **如果陌生人或无法核实身份的人通过电话、短信或聊天要求你安装 RustDesk，请立即停止安装并挂断电话。**
> **不要让陌生人查看或操作网银、支付软件、验证码或个人资料。对方可能正试图盗取你的钱款和隐私。**
> 有疑问时，请通过你自行查找的官方渠道核实，勿使用对方提供的联系方式。

> [!CAUTION]
> # 🚨 REMOTE ACCESS SCAM ALERT!
> **Stop if an unexpected caller or message asks you to install RustDesk. End the call and verify the request independently.**
> **Never let an unverified person control your banking or payment apps, read verification codes, or access private files. They may be attempting to steal your money or identity.**
> Contact the organization using details you find yourself, not details supplied by the caller.
